current.text: He is projected to start for Phoenix.
He was having a career year last season but collapsed late. He shot about 38% from the field over the final two months.
He will play less at the four now that Miles Bridges has arrived.
Phoenix has crowded usage. Booker, Jalen Green, Brooks, Collin Gillespie and Bridges will all want touches, so his shot volume is likely to fall from last season.
In an ESPN points-league mock draft, the expert was not interested at all in him in round 12 and called it a shocking pick.

durable.text: He has a good defensive reputation. Josh calls him the only clearly above-average defender in the projected Phoenix starting group.

note: Both sites rank him around 140 (Yahoo 142, ESPN 138) with a 0 USD value, so in our 144-player draft he is a 1 USD final pick at most, or a waiver option. He brings threes, points and FT% but costs FG% (43% projected), and his 20.2 PTS last season came on 17.1 FGA, while the projections drop that to 13.5 to 15.8 FGA. In the first weeks, check whether he keeps his shot volume next to Booker, Green and Bridges and whether his FG% recovers from the late-season slump (about 38%).
